query.name: Current client world
query.command: oql "SELECT c.field_1687 AS world,c.field_1724 AS player FROM net.minecraft.class_310 c"

query.name: All client worlds
query.command: oql "SELECT c,c.@retainedHeapSize AS retained FROM net.minecraft.class_638 c"

query.name: EMI search indexes
query.command: oql "SELECT c,c.@retainedHeapSize AS retained FROM dev.emi.emi.search.SuffixArray c"
